# projectWizard

## Overview
New project wizard templates and builders (DartModuleBuilder, DartProjectGenerator).

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.projectWizard.DartModuleBuilder
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.projectWizard.DartProjectGenerator

## Invariants
- Generates initial Dart project file structure (pubspec.yaml, main.dart).

## Side Effects
- Creates new project directories and files on disk.
